title: VulnSafe: Measuring Vulnerability-Aware Relational Safety in Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.34819v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Emotionally supportive interactions require large language models not only to avoid overtly harmful content, but also to recognize vulnerability-related risk, regulate their relational stance, preserve user agency, and provide context-appropriate support. Existing safety benchmarks often measure isolated violations, leaving unclear what underlying response competence their scores represent. We introduce VulnSafe, a Chinese capability assessment centered on Vulnerability-Aware Response Competence (VARC). VARC organizes relational safety into five complementary constructs: Risk Perception, Safety Preservation, Autonomy Protection, Supportive Response, and Boundary Management. Following an evidence-centered design, 41 scenarios elicit construct-relevant behavior through 2,050 balanced prompts and scenario-specific scoring rubrics. The assessment further separates proactive should-do behavior from prohibitive should-not behavior. Across eigh

translated_title: VulnSafe：测量大语言模型中的脆弱性感知关系安全
translated_abstract: 情感支持型交互要求大语言模型不仅要避免明显有害的内容，还要识别与脆弱性相关的风险、调节自身的关系立场、保护用户的自主性，并提供符合情境的支持。现有的安全基准通常测量孤立的违规行为，导致其分数所代表的底层响应能力并不明确。我们提出了VulnSafe，一个以脆弱性感知响应能力（VARC）为核心的中文能力评估。VARC将关系安全组织为五个互补的构念：风险感知、安全维护、自主性保护、支持性响应和边界管理。遵循以证据为中心的设计，41个场景通过2,050个平衡的提示词和针对场景的评分细则来引出与构念相关的行为。该评估进一步将主动的“应该做”行为与禁止性的“不应该做”行为区分开来，并在八（原文此处截断）
tldr: VulnSafe提出了一个以脆弱性感知响应能力（VARC）为核心的中文评估基准，通过41个场景、2050个平衡提示词，从风险感知、安全维护、自主性保护、支持性响应和边界管理五个维度系统评估大语言模型的关系安全能力，并区分主动的“应该做”与禁止性的“不应该做”行为。
en_tdlr: VulnSafe introduces a Chinese benchmark for Vulnerability-Aware Response Competence (VARC), evaluating LLMs' relational safety across five constructs—risk perception, safety preservation, autonomy protection, supportive response, and boundary management—using 41 scenarios and 2,050 balanced prompts that distinguish proactive should-do from prohibitive should-not behaviors.
